permissions.location: requested only after explicit user action; watch is cleared when the page/session ends
permissions.camera: requested only after explicit user action; stream tracks stop when disabled or page/session ends
permissions.microphone: not requested by the local core
permissions.backgroundLocation: not enabled by the local web core

providerBoundary.secretPolicy: provider secrets must never be embedded in browser source
providerBoundary.fallback: provider failure falls back to the local route-preview core

storage.clearSession: must stop location watch, stop camera tracks and clear route state

releaseGates: PWA install does not require third-party CDN assets
location is not requested on page load
camera is not requested on page load
no browser source contains provider secret keys
session clear stops location and camera access
production provider integrations receive separate security review
